title: 2023 Panini Select Certified Tommy Devito Rookie #CRO-TDE Giants
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Panini Select Certified sports trading card featuring Tommy Devito, a player for the New York Giants in the National Football League (NFL). It is an exclusive rookie insert made of card stock and manufactured by Panini in the United States. The card measures 3½" x 2½" and is an original licensed reprint. It is part of the 2023 season collection with card number CRO-TDE.
